parallels.note: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.

translations.web: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.
translations.bsb: He answered, “It is one of the Twelve—the one who is dipping his hand into the bowl with Me.
translations.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
translations.asv: And he said unto them, It is one of the twelve, he that dippeth with me in the dish.
